# UI window and interaction inventory

This page is generated from the declarative UI catalog. It inventories the current user-facing surfaces, their major workflows, the automated evidence available, and real production screenshots. It does **not** claim that a screenshot or a visible control proves the complete workflow.

| Coverage status | Screens | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| Contracted | 13 | Widget-level execute/result assertions are registered and run in CI. |
| Partial | 3 | Targeted GUI, integration, model, or screenshot checks exist; the full control matrix is not contracted. |
| Inventory only | 0 | Inventory only — systematic UI contracts remain future work; window/workflow is documented here for discovery and rollout planning. |

The Functional Block Library, legacy Task Hub, transient choosers, Add PCB Layout, Record picker, Instance Configuration, Implementation details, Implementations Manager, Manage Libraries, PCB Layout Manager, and Facade Pin Layout editor have registered widget contracts. Create Block from Sheet is a one-click Eeschema action rather than a details form. All 49 native messagebox/simpledialog call sites have direct result/effect contracts. Place Block uses supported page-aware schematic IPC placement, focus and selection while the schematic interactive-move API is pending; Edit Facade provides a project-local pin-layout editor with immediate persistence and safe publishing. Native Symbol Editor launch and cursor-attached placement remain upstream API gaps, not disabled features or OS-specific automation paths. The shared file chooser wrappers have argument/cancellation contracts; native OS rendering and cross-process KiCad window ownership remain unverified.

## Screens

### Legacy Task Hub

Compatibility-only grouped command panel; direct Eeschema plugin actions and the Functional Block Library are the intended workflow.

**Coverage:** Contracted — widget action and expected UI transition asserted.

Legacy compatibility screen. Action buttons track the live Eeschema selection and required prerequisites, poll while open, and recheck before dispatch. Disabled actions do not close the panel. This panel is not the intended create/place/publish workflow.

**Views and actions**

- **Use & build**

### Facade pin layout editor

Adjust the external pin positions, angles, and lengths of a selected block facade. Pin names, numbers, and electrical types remain derived from the implementation's hierarchical-label interface.

**Coverage:** Contracted — widget action and expected UI transition asserted.

The real Tk editor, selected-pin table, geometry fields, immediate catalog write, project-library reload, optimistic concurrency guard, invalid-value recovery, and Close action are covered by interaction and file-format contracts. - View every facade pin with its current number and electrical type
- Edit the selected pin's X/Y position, orientation, and length

### Instance configuration

Change the selected schematic instance's profile, implementation, typed parameters, and PCB layout.

**Coverage:** Contracted — widget action and expected UI transition asserted.

Every application-owned interactive control has a stable semantic ID and real-Tk contracts. Tests select a profile and assert that its implementation, typed parameters, and PCB layout are applied; manually edit a parameter and verify the profile becomes Custom; save the values through one undoable KiCad IPC transaction; reject invalid parameter values without starting an IPC edit and recover; cancel with the button or Escape; and assert rollback after an IPC update failure. Missing required facade fields are rejected before the dialog opens. The existing live Eeschema GUI test separately verifies a real KiCad editor hand-off and save.

**Major functionality**

- Select a profile or a custom configuration
- Choose an implementation and PCB layout
- Edit typed parameter values
- Save one undoable schematic update or cancel

**Registered semantic controls**

- Configure selected schematic instance (`instance-configuration.window`; window; behavior asserted)
- Configuration profile (`instance-configuration.profile`; combobox; behavior asserted)
- Implementation variant (`instance-configuration.variant`; combobox; behavior asserted)
- Typed parameter value (one semantic ID per parameter) (`instance-configuration.parameter.{name}`; entry-or-combobox; behavior asserted)
- PCB layout (`instance-configuration.layout`; combobox; behavior asserted)
- Save instance (`instance-configuration.action.save`; button; behavior asserted)
- Cancel (`instance-configuration.action.cancel`; button; behavior asserted)

### Create Block from Sheet

Package one selected hierarchical sheet, or the sheet currently open in Eeschema when nothing is selected, as a reusable functional block.

**Coverage:** Partial — targeted GUI, integration, or visual checks exist.

This is a native Eeschema action rather than a Tk window. The real Eeschema IPC integration test verifies typed SheetSymbol selection, active-subsheet creation with an empty selection, derived facade pins, catalog/library registration, collision-safe naming, rollback on failure, and unchanged source files. The action does not open a naming form or success popup.

**Major functionality**

- Select exactly one hierarchical sheet symbol in its parent schematic
- With no selection, use the sheet currently open in Eeschema
- Derive a collision-safe block name from the source filename and create it in the configured default library
- Copy the complete child-sheet hierarchy, derive facade pins from root hierarchical labels, and register the project catalog

**Major functionality**

### PCB Layout Manager

Maintain stored PCB layouts, default selection, and implementation associations.

**Coverage:** Contracted — widget action and expected UI transition asserted.

All registered manager controls are exercised with real Tk interactions. Every Add, Remove, Assign, and Set default operation persists immediately; a failed write is retried by Close, which keeps the manager open until the change is safely stored.

**Major functionality**

- Add, remove, or set a layout as Default
- Assign a layout to one or more implementations
- Refresh the table after mutations
- Persist accepted changes and report write failures

**Registered semantic controls**

- PCB Layout Manager dialog (`pcb-layout-manager.window`; window; behavior asserted)
- Stored PCB layouts (`pcb-layout-manager.rows`; treeview; behavior asserted)

### Error, confirmation, and report dialogs

Explain blocked operations, recoverable errors, destructive confirmations, and completed reports.

**Coverage:** Partial — targeted GUI, integration, or visual checks exist.

The production plugin contains 56 native messagebox/simpledialog call sites across profile creation, source/layout selection, validation, library and implementation maintenance, the Functional Block Library, PCB mapping/anchor/rotation, and action dispatch. The AST-generated registry links all 56 call sites to direct result/effect tests (56 tested, 0 partial, 0 uncovered). This screen remains partial only because those tests stub the OS dialogs: actual native-window rendering, focus/ownership, and platform-specific button layout are not covered by the in-process contracts.

**Major functionality**

- Assert an error is visible and identifies the failed operation
- Assert a confirmation includes the consequence and cancel path
- Assert completed actions report through the expected passive feedback channel
- Assert error handling does not silently leave partial files or registrations

### KiCad editors and native file choosers

Open and focus KiCad-owned schematic, symbol, and PCB documents, or select files using the operating system's native dialogs.

**Coverage:** Partial — targeted GUI, integration, or visual checks exist.

The shared Tk native-dialog wrappers now have direct execute/result contracts for existing/missing initial paths, extension filters, suggested save names/extensions, parent-window ownership arguments, must-exist directory selection, fallback-to-current-directory behavior, and user cancellation. Real KiCad GUI/IPC tests separately cover schematic editor launch/edit/save, symbol facade placement, and PCB document load/save. Actual OS-native chooser rendering, window-manager focus/ownership, and the complete editor hand-off matrix on Windows and macOS remain unverified; this is not cross-platform sign-off.

**Major functionality**

- Launch or focus the correct KiCad editor and document
- Preserve the selected library item or project context
- Test native file/directory chooser filters, initial paths, and cancellation
- Separate proven IPC behavior from platform-specific window-manager behavior

**Registered semantic controls**

- Open KiCad schematic/PCB file chooser wrapper (`kicad-native-documents.open-file`; native-file-dialog; behavior asserted)

## Coverage interpretation

- **Contracted** means the listed UI component's actual Tcl/Tk command was executed and its expected callback or visible state transition was asserted. It is not a substitute for verifying a downstream KiCad operation or a native OS file chooser.
- **Partial** means there are useful targeted checks, but one or more controls, views, failure paths, or side effects are not covered by reusable contracts.
- **Inventory only** means the screen and its major functions are recorded for discovery and rollout planning; do not treat it as tested.

Per-control status is explicit: **behavior asserted** means a real interaction is executed and checked; **result observed** means a dependent state (such as a selected row's label or a visible pane) is checked; **discovered; interaction not yet asserted** means the control is present but its action still needs an interaction contract.

For the reusable component model and framework decisions, see [UI testing architecture](explanation/ui-testing-architecture.md).
